name: Thompson Seattle
insider_take: Where Pike Place Market meets luxury - Thompson Seattle puts you in the heart of the Emerald City's most vibrant neighborhood.
whats_special: This boutique gem sits just steps from Pike Place Market and Seattle's waterfront, offering stunning views of Elliott Bay. The hotel's rooftop bar, The Nest, provides panoramic vistas of the Olympic Mountains and Puget Sound. As part of the Hyatt Privé program, guests enjoy exclusive perks like complimentary breakfast and room upgrades.
pro_tip: Book a bay-view room on higher floors for unobstructed sunset views over Elliott Bay, and time your rooftop visit during golden hour when the Olympic Mountains glow.
dont_miss: The original Starbucks at Pike Place Market is a 2-minute walk away, while the iconic fish throwing vendors and local artisan stalls create an authentic Seattle experience right outside your door. The Seattle Art Museum and waterfront attractions are all within easy walking distance.
pros: Sweeping Puget Sound & Seattle skyline views from rooftop bar and guest rooms
Prime Pike Place Market & waterfront location, steps from Seattle's best dining and attractions
Stylish, design-forward rooms with Pacific Northwest-inspired décor and premium finishes
Exclusive Hyatt Privé benefits including upgrades, daily breakfast, and resort credits
Highly praised rooftop bar and on-site dining with locally inspired cuisine
cons: Urban downtown setting may feel bustling for guests seeking a quiet retreat
Valet-only parking adds additional cost to the stay
